text: The Terms of Reference for the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee state that the Committee will hold up to six meetings per year at the call of the Chair or Vice-Chairs on delegation of the Chair. The Chair has scheduled the following meetings for 2026: Date: Friday, February 27, 2026 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location: Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference Date: Monday, May 4, 2026 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location: Committee Room 2, City Hall/Video Conference Date: Monday, June 15, 2026 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location: Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference The schedule of meetings for Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid days of cultural or religious significance.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
